about_the_game: Your tiny desktop companions will never leave you alone! Choose your own digital pet, feed it, and form a peaceful bond. Accompanied by soothing sounds and a relaxing atmosphere, care for your adorable cat, rabbit, or hedgehog friend. In this desktop pet simulation, you can escape the hustle and bustle of daily life and take a tranquil break in your own little world.

short_description: Meet your tiny companions in this adorable desktop pet simulation. Feed them with care, play together, and create a cozy home with colorful decorations. Whether you’re working, gaming, or on a break, spend time with these charming friends.
